answer: Each challenge commits to a task instance whose salt is derived only after a future, unbiasable threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so its cipher, difficulty, and acceptance path cannot be known in advance. A commit-reveal audit binds the claimant to that pulse and exposes equivocation. Thus a sybil swarm cannot precompute answers, farm offline, or cheaply clone identities; labels such as summit and yarrow gain no advantage without the unpredictable beacon.
